payload.name: Extract Reasons Behind Stated Choices
payload.description: Use when a user explains why they chose or decided on something, stating the reasons or considerations behind the choice.
content: During extraction, if a message explicitly states why the user made a choice or decision (e.g., 'I chose X because...', 'I wanted Y'), capture those reasons as part of the candidate memory instead of recording only the outcome or a vague summary.
Preserve each stated reason separately (e.g., personal style, customer comfort) rather than merging them into one generic descriptor.
When enriching or updating an existing memory about the choice, ADD the newly stated reasons to the memory content rather than overwriting previous facets.
Stop after capturing the explicitly stated reasons; do not infer unmentioned motivations.

solves: Conversations where a user explicitly states the reasons or considerations behind a choice or decision, and memory extraction records only the outcome or a vague summary, losing the rationale needed to answer future 'why' questions.
